agents.parser: Exactly one JSON object with action keys; surrounding prose is ignored by caller only. Original replies/history remain unchanged.

method_notes: Real APIs, synthetic data, fixed caller prompts; no LLM-based grading.
Main default/high cores use fork; high core inherits driver report heap. Do not compare its RSS directly with a clean spawn core.
Supplement uses spawn, separate driver/core, throttled driver report saves and pool observations.
Guard, trace fsync and health polling add overhead; this is not a 10 ms local-overhead budget certification.
Initial sustained load assigns article/sentiment to MiMo and coding/design to relay; only balanced supplement uses the same mix for both.
Direct/relay generation and output lengths differ; end-to-end differences are not local forwarding overhead.
Direct HTTP client timeout is 180 seconds with a 200-second outer deadline. Gateway uses connect=10s, pool=5s, upstream read=150s and total=180s.
Unknown usage is null. Provider-reported zero input is preserved, not inferred to mean free usage.
Original raw scores used the old Chinese numeric-boundary checker; reviewed scores apply the corrected offline checker. Raw replies are unchanged.
Strict JSON, removal of one enclosing JSON fence, and extraction of a unique action JSON are distinct caller-side scenarios, not gateway rewriting.
